q.en: "Parliament ___ new legislation to tighten environmental standards."
q.bn: "Parliament ___ new legislation to tighten environmental standards."

why.en: "Passed" is the past simple form, needed for this completed past action.
why.bn: "Passed" past simple form, এই completed past action-এর জন্য এটাই লাগবে।

why.en: "Allegations of corruption" is the standard collocation for accusations of dishonest or illegal conduct.
why.bn: "Allegations of corruption" standard collocation, অসৎ বা অবৈধ আচরণের অভিযোগের জন্য।

q.en: Which pair contrasts elected leadership with centralised, restricted power?
q.bn: কোন pair elected leadership আর centralised, restricted power-এর মধ্যে contrast দেখায়?

why.en: A "democracy" has elected leaders and protected civil liberties; an "authoritarian regime" has centralised, restricted power.
why.bn: "Democracy"-তে elected leader এবং civil liberties protected থাকে; "authoritarian regime"-এ power centralised এবং restricted।

q.en: "Voter ___ was notably low in the last election."
q.bn: "Voter ___ was notably low in the last election."

why.en: "Voter turnout" refers to the proportion of eligible voters who actually voted.
why.bn: "Voter turnout" মানে ভোট দেওয়ার যোগ্য মানুষদের মধ্যে আসলে কতজন ভোট দিয়েছে।

q.en: Which word family member fits: "The agency is a ___ body responsible for enforcing health regulations." (govern / government / governmental)
q.bn: কোন word family member ঠিক বসবে: "The agency is a ___ body responsible for enforcing health regulations." (govern / government / governmental)

why.en: "Governmental" is the adjective form, needed here to describe the type of "body".
why.bn: "Governmental" adjective form, "body"-র ধরন বর্ণনা করতে এটাই লাগবে।
